meta.name: ponytail
meta.description: Forces the laziest solution that actually works, simplest, shortest, most minimal. Channels a senior dev who has seen everything: question whether the task needs to exist at all (YAGNI), reach for the standard library before custom code, native platform features before dependencies, one line before fifty. Supports intensity levels: lite, full (default), ultra. Use on ANY coding task: writing, adding, refactoring, fixing, reviewing, or designing code, and choosing libraries or dependencies. Also use whenever the user says "ponytail", "be lazy", "lazy mode", "simplest solution", "minimal solution", "yagni", "do less", or "shortest path", or complains about over-engineering, bloat, boilerplate, or unnecessary dependencies. Do NOT use for non-coding requests (general knowledge, prose, translation, summaries, recipes).

copy.tagline: 简化代码到最简可运行版本
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果写代码总想堆砌复杂方案,想要最短实现。
copy.tagline_en: Simplify your code to the simplest working version.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you tend to over-engineer and want the shortest path.

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 会强制采用“最懒但能用”的解法：优先复用现有代码、标准库和平台自带功能，避免自造轮子和多余依赖，并会质疑任务本身是否必要。支持 lite、full、ultra 三档强度。
howto.when: 用于任何编码任务，如写代码、重构、修复；或者你说出“ponytail”“be lazy”等词，或抱怨代码过度设计时触发。不要用于非编码请求。

say.text: 用 ponytail 简化这段代码
say.note: Claude 会按最简方案重写。

say.text: 这个依赖有必要吗？用 lazy mode 检查
say.note: 它会判断能否用标准库替代。

say.text: 用 ultra 模式，去掉不必要的设计
say.note: 它会删除多余抽象并挑战需求。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will force the laziest solution that actually works: reuse existing code, stdlib, and native features first, avoid custom code and unnecessary dependencies, and question whether the task is needed at all. Supports lite, full, and ultra levels.
howto.when_en: For any coding task (writing, refactoring, fixing, etc.) or when you say "ponytail"/"be lazy" or complain about over-engineering. Not for non-coding requests.

say_en.note: Claude rewrites it in the minimal way.

say_en.text: Is this dependency needed? Check with lazy mode.
say_en.note: It checks if stdlib can replace it.

say_en.text: Use ultra mode, remove unneeded design.
say_en.note: It deletes extra abstractions and challenges requirements.
